summary: Revised implementation plan incorporating: (1) omitting setCustomBigContentView (keeping bigContentView = null) and standard builder.addAction rows so Android/HyperOS renders zero expand/collapse chevron arrows (^); (2) showing RecordingIslandOverlayManager exclusively when MainActivity moves to the background/Home Screen and hiding it when MainActivity is in the foreground; and (3) proactively prompting once for Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_OVERLAY_PERMISSION on first recording/backgrounding when overlay permission is not yet granted.
